skills.name: humanizer
skills.notes: Re-synced 2026-09-12 against upstream v3.0.0 (9862685, 2026-09-06). This is a real merge, not an overwrite: upstream's structural half was adopted -- the severity model (act-on-sight vs 'weak alone'), the structure-before-vocabulary A-E grouping, the fact guardrail, the three output modes, the prompt-injection line, the 'when not to act' exemptions, and patterns 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 10, 11, 17, 30, 31. Flywheel-only content was kept: the VOICE.md/_VOICE.md nearest-ancestor resolution and cascade (Step 0), the personality-and-soul section, and patterns for burstiness, transition-word density, elegant variation, false ranges, abstract verb inflation and filler phrases, which upstream does not carry. Result is local v3.0.0 with 31 patterns. local_modifications stays true, so 'vendor-sync.sh pull humanizer' will print a diff for manual merge rather than overwrite -- that is correct, the two catalogues have diverged by design. The earlier retroactive pinned_sha (e2e92e7, 2026-08-21 HEAD) was a diff baseline, not a fork point; this one is a real sync point.
